paragraphs: Mondays, 11:00 AWST. Two blocks of 45 minutes — same structure every week so the rhythm becomes second nature; only the contents change.
Block A — Channel & Stock, with Chris. Block B — Sales, Compliance & Ops, with Mick, Sam and Bec.
Recorded by Fathom; we do not take live notes. Afterwards, decisions are logged and Mick's actions captured to the task queue.

items: Settled (logged 22 Jun): First Home Owner and NDIS stock are exempt — Chris keeps these outside the portal; everything else stays in-channel.
Any other grey area on what must go through TPCH? If none, this item retires.
Builders to land — keep on top of these: Ozbuild, Melbourne Square, Melbourne Builder, Amit, Emmett. Each: meeting booked? next step? who's chasing?
New channels: where is the next tranche of stock coming from — Chris's leads and targets.
Lock it in: the 2–3 builders we get in front of this week, and the owner for each.
Fast pass over current deals; surface blockers and Chris's read before he drops off.
Evers / Marco — agent-stamp via Becky ($2k fee, commission $11k to $8k): go or no-go?

sections.text: Block B — Mick · Sam · Bec · 45 min

items: Settlements this week and month; live pipeline value; deals at risk.
Marco 2201 EGLE (top priority) — valuation was blocked (Bo Residential, no entry notice); finance deadline was 20 Jun, now passed. Did it clear?
Peel Street — $155k land held under the First Home Owner Grant threshold. Go/no-go from Rach, Rhys, Stacey?
Onboarding calls — Dan Peterson, Shane Robson: done / outcome?
Real estate licence: Becky stopgap ($2k per contract) versus Sam getting his own licence ASAP — timeline and decision.
AML/CTF (AUSTRAC): TPCH enrolling as a brokered designated service, live 1 Jul. AUSTRAC registration (Mick + Chris); Teams call with Lynn; Part A/B program build; InfoTrack + 7-year storage.
Area profiles — Port Hedland draft; branding/logo files.
Minyip write-up out to Greg Morris, Elmayne, Craig Settle.
Portal promoter research — LinkedIn/databases for people to promote the portal (Minnip 5.5★ as the hook).
Lock recurring Monday meetings to the 11:00 AWST slot.
